normalize_GTest_JSON_output: normalize Google Test JSON output by replacing timestamps, times, and stack traces with wildcards
normalize_time_fields: normalize time fields in a dict by replacing duration strings like 1.23s with asterisks
normalize_timestamp_fields: normalize timestamp fields in a dict by replacing ISO 8601 timestamps with asterisks
normalize_failure_messages: normalize failure messages by replacing file line numbers and stack traces with wildcards
normalize_nested_JSON: recursively normalize nested dicts and lists of Google Test JSON output objects
